basic_details.short_information: Andaman & Nicobar Union Territory Health Mission (A&N UT Health Mission) Renal Technician, Physiotherapist & Radiographer Recruitment 2026 notification has been released for eligible candidates. A total of 8 vacancies have been announced through the A&N UT Health Mission Renal Technician, Physiotherapist & Radiographer Recruitment 2026.

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 60 years for all posts.

qualification.education_qualification: 12th Standard, Diploma in Dialysis Technology, Graduate in Physiotherapy, Degree/Diploma in Radiography
qualification.details: Renal Technician: 12th Std. (Senior School Certificate Examination) passed from a recognized Board/Institution. 02 years Diploma in Dialysis Technology from a recognized University/Institution or its equivalent. Must pass trade test being conducted by the Department. Physiotherapist: Graduate in Physiotherapy with 3 years experience. Working knowledge of computers. Radiographer: 12th Standard from recognized Board/Institution. Degree/Diploma in Radiography from a recognized institution. Desirable: 1-2 years experience in the field.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for A&N UT Health Mission Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website:andamannicobar.gov.in/ .
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 28-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the A&N UT Health Mission Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the A&N UT Health Mission Recruitment 2026 is 28th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies released by A&N UT Health Mission?
faq.answer: A total of 8 vacancies have been released by the Andaman & Nicobar Union Territory Health Mission for the posts of Renal Technician, Physiotherapist, and Radiographer.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for these posts will receive a salary of Rs. 25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the eligibility criteria for the Renal Technician post?
faq.answer: For the Renal Technician post, candidates must have passed 12th Standard and possess a 02 years Diploma in Dialysis Technology from a recognized institution. A trade test is also required.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts under this recruitment is 60 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the A&N UT Health Mission Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Trade Test, Interview, and will be based on Merit.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What are the educational qualifications for the Radiographer post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Radiographer post must have passed 12th Standard and hold a Degree/Diploma in Radiography from a recognized institution. Experience is desirable.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Andaman & Nicobar Union Territory Health Mission. Links are provided in the 'Important Links' section.
